description: Create a collection: a new resource (like a table) with its own REST endpoint at /api/collections/{slug}/records. Use one per kind of thing the app stores (tasks, users, orders). Free projects allow 3.

api_key.description: Project manage key (pro_...) returned by create_project. Public keys (pub_...) are read-only.

name.description: Human-readable name, e.g. "Tasks"; the slug is derived from it

name: create_collection
title: Create a collection
